name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Magnetic Phone Grip
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from premium acrylic material with a thickness of 3 mm, providing durability and a smooth, glossy finish.
    - Includes a transparent phone grip base designed for comfortable handling and long-term use.
    - Equipped with a strong magnetic connection that securely attaches the acrylic grip to the metal ring.
    - Comes with a high-quality adhesive metal ring that sticks firmly to your phone or phone case.
    - Built with durable adhesive dots for strong attachment and stable daily use.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Grip Design Size Options:
                +) 1.5 x 1.5 in ~3.81 x 3.81 cm.
                +) 2 x 2 in ~5.08 x 5.08 cm.
                +) 2.5 x 2.5 in ~6.35 x 6.35 cm.
    - Phone Grip Base Diameter: 2.2 in ~ 5.6 cm.
    - Metal Ring Diameter: 2.16 in ~ 5.5 cm.
    - Thickness:
                +) Folded: 0.31 in ~ 0.8 cm.
                +) Expanded: 0.67 in ~ 1.7 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - 1-sided printing on the acrylic surface ensures clear artwork while maintaining a clean transparent backing.
    - The printing process provides long-lasting color quality and fade resistance.
    - Smooth surface finishing enhances both visual clarity and scratch resistance.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Provides a secure and comfortable grip when holding your phone with one hand.
    - Helps reduce the risk of dropping your phone during daily use.
    - Functions as a convenient phone stand for watching videos, video calls, or browsing.
    - The magnetic detachable design allows easy removal and reattachment when needed.
    - Compatible with most smartphones and phone cases.

 

  • How to Use:
    - Peel the adhesive backing from the included metal ring.
    - Stick the metal ring onto the back of your phone or phone case and press firmly.
    - Attach the magnetic phone grip onto the metal ring.
    - Expand or fold the grip as needed for comfortable holding or hands-free viewing.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A practical and stylish accessory for family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, or special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who enjoys personalized phone accessories and functional daily items.
    - Combines usefulness, creativity, and personalization, making it a thoughtful and meaningful gift.🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Magnetic Phone Grip

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
